gaps.sentence: His wife goes to ___ prison every Sunday to visit him.
gaps.explanation: Here 'the prison' is the building she visits, not the institution of imprisonment.

gaps.sentence: He earns fifty thousand pounds ___ year.
gaps.explanation: 'Fifty thousand a year' — 'a' = per in rates.
Single mountain peaks take no article: Everest, Mont Blanc (compare: the Alps).
Both 'happiness' and 'money' are general here, so no article for either gap.

gaps.sentence: We bought ___ antique mirror at the flea market.
gaps.explanation: 'An antique mirror' — 'antique' starts with a vowel sound.
'Inflation' as a general economic concept takes no article.

gaps.sentence: It was ___ best film of the decade by common consent.
___ Alps attract skiers from all over the world.
gaps.explanation: Mountain ranges take 'the' (the Alps), but single peaks take no article (Everest).
